field_description_long.value: These Chinese Land Records are important and valuable primary documentation that reflect the land ownership in different historical periods, land tenure changes and land management system of China. As historical records they are indispensable for research and studies of Chinese politics, economy, social life, etc. Digital reproductions of the collection are available online. 这些珍贵的原始文献不仅提供了中国不同历史时期的土地所有，产权转让，土地管理系统的历史信息，也是研究中国政治史，经济史，社会生活史不可或缺的珍贵史料。检索指南包含了数字化副本​。

field_scope_content.value: The collection of Chinese Land Records at University Library System, University of Pittsburgh include land deeds, property trade documents, possession draw documents, tax bills, etc. It includes 220 pieces that span over three hundred years from the Ming Dynasty (1368-1644) to mid-twentieth century. The majority of them are from Fujian Province and several are from other provinces. 匹兹堡大学图书馆拥有的中国土地文书文献共220份，包括地契、土地买卖文书、家族析产书、土地税收据，等等。时间跨度上自明代(1368-1644)，下至20世纪50年代。除少部分出自其他省份，绝大部分出自于福建省。
